description: Search the App Store or Google Play by app name / keyword. Returns app summaries with the `id` to use in other tools.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 storefront, e.g. us, gb, de, jp (default us).

lang.description: Android only: listing language, e.g. en, es (default en).

store.description: ios or android. Defaults to ios; inferred from the id when omitted.

name: search_apps
